says: Modelling the gourds cheaply, as suggested: every tower now keeps a thin crescent of white moonlight just inside the edge that faces the moon, then a band of lighter single hatching, then its core tone, so they turn as round volumes instead of cutouts. The balcony pair are larger but still well under the doorway; the nearer one turns toward the city and points out at it with a raised arm, and both keep their moonward edges white inside a white rim. The sky is laid once, lighter, with a fine point so it stays even; I sharpened for the focal pair and again for the sky.
